CLASS: B.ARCH   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: ARCHITECTURE   SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: AR252 BUILDING SERVICES-II (ELECTRICAL AND LIGHTING)
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates

   CO BL
Q.1(a) What is the use of Transformer and explain its working principle? [2] A Lvl.1
Q.1(b) Explain the one type of electricity generations with its components and mechanism. [3] B Lvl.1


Q.2(a) What do you understand by short-circuiting and Overloading? [2] A Lvl.1
Q.2(b) Explain  Overhead  and  Underground  Electricity  supply  line  with  advantages  and
disadvantages associated with both the option.
[3] B Lvl.2


Q.3(a) What is the provision for protection of buildings against lightning? [2] A Lvl.2
Q.3(b) Describe  the  Electricity  Generation  and  supply  system  with  the  help  of  neat
sketches/Diagramme.
[3] B Lvl.1


Q.4(a) For a Power transformer what will be the output voltage if the input Voltage is 200V,
and no of turns in the primary and secondary coil is 25 and 15 respectively?
[2] A Lvl.2
Q.4(b) Draw a Single Line Plan of a 1BHK and do the Electrical layout of that. [3] C Lvl.6


Q.5(a) What are the factors for deciding voltage for any Electrical transmission line? [2] A Lvl.2
Q.5(b) If 100MW Electric energy supplied through two different voltages, in 1st distribution line
@200  V  in  2
nd
  @ 2.5KV  assuming  ideal distribution  cable  of  5  ohm  resistance in  both
situations, what will be the power loss in both the distribution line?
[3] B Lvl.3
